title: Ruthless Bar Salts B.nana On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Banana on Ice delivers a smooth and creamy Banana flavour, perfectly balanced with a crisp menthol finish. The rich, velvety sweetness of ripe Bananas creates a luscious inhale, while the cool, refreshing exhale adds a frosty contrast, making this an indulgent yet revitalising vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a consistently smooth and flavour-packed vape. The nicotine salt formulation provides a comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy fruit and menthol pairings. Ruthless is one of the most influential brands in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have inspired the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to be a favourite among vapers on both sides of the pond who prize high-quality, distinct, and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in vape juice.
